requirements.requirement: node2 and node3 can reach each other on TCP port 8080 through node1
requirements.summary: Real TCP listeners on node2/node3 were connected to across the node1 transit links successfully in both directions (cmd-ddfc48eae05b4cd3, cmd-cb57fb642e8d4744) after the ACL was applied, and again after all three nodes were rebooted (cmd-264de7d92cac4e7a, cmd-aecf2688ff674e31, cmd-2fa0865d04e6489c, cmd-ce40e55576734adb).

requirements.requirement: node1 refuses (actively rejects) TCP port 23 traffic passing between node2 and node3
requirements.summary: After loading an nftables forward-hook table on node1 with tcp/23 reject-with-tcp-reset rules for both directions of the transit subnets, connection attempts to a real port-23 listener return ECONNREFUSED in both directions (cmd-ddfc48eae05b4cd3, cmd-cb57fb642e8d4744), and the loaded ruleset is directly inspected (cmd-42cd383bfb0a43a7). Behavior persists after reboot of all three nodes (cmd-264de7d92cac4e7a, cmd-aecf2688ff674e31, cmd-2fa0865d04e6489c, cmd-ce40e55576734adb).

requirements.requirement: the rest of the forwarded traffic between node2 and node3 is left untouched
requirements.summary: ICMP ping across the transit links continued to succeed with the ACL loaded (cmd-1af864086d8248e8), and the inspected nftables ruleset shows only the two tcp/23 reject rules with a default-accept forward policy, so no other traffic class is filtered (cmd-42cd383bfb0a43a7).

requirements.requirement: node1 restart evidence: healthy baseline, bounded disruption, recovery with restored config/behavior
requirements.summary: Pre-restart boot_id (8e8823ec...) captured, backgrounded systemctl reboot issued, connection loss/timeout observed during the disruption window, new boot_id (76e1182c...) confirmed post-restart, all 9 SONiC containers confirmed healthy, transit IPs/sysctl forwarding/nftables ACL table shown auto-restored, and 8080-allowed/23-refused behavior re-verified live.

requirements.requirement: node2 restart evidence: healthy baseline, bounded disruption, recovery with restored config/behavior
requirements.summary: Pre-restart boot_id (3dba43a5...) captured, backgrounded systemctl reboot issued, connection timeouts observed during disruption, new boot_id (07a0279f...) confirmed, eth1 IP/route and firewalld permanent ports shown auto-restored, and 8080-allowed/23-refused behavior re-verified from node3.

requirements.requirement: node3 restart evidence: healthy baseline, bounded disruption, recovery with restored config/behavior
requirements.summary: Pre-restart boot_id (b35fad86...) captured, backgrounded systemctl reboot issued, connection timeouts observed during disruption, new boot_id (47a4398d...) confirmed, eth1 IP/route and firewalld permanent ports shown auto-restored, and bidirectional 8080-allowed/23-refused behavior re-verified.

overall_summary: The executor established point-to-point transit links on node1 (SONiC) between node2 and node3, enabled forwarding, added static routes, and deployed an nftables forward-hook ACL on node1 that rejects TCP/23 in both directions while leaving TCP/8080 and ICMP untouched. All three material outcomes (8080 reachable, 23 refused, rest untouched) are directly demonstrated with real TCP connection tests and ICMP pings, and confirmed to persist correctly across an actual reboot of all three nodes with distinct pre/post boot identities, service health checks, and re-verified functional behavior.
limitations: Package-health checks on node2 and node3 timed out in both before_prepare and after_executor snapshots, so package-manager consistency cannot be independently verified for those nodes.
Leftover Python test-listener processes and files on node2/node3 were not cleaned up after verification, though they are low-risk and unrelated to the ACL enforcement itself.

operational_hygiene.summary: All state-changing commands trace to interface/IP setup, forwarding enablement, static routing, the ACL itself, or bounded functional test scaffolding and its bootstrap-related host firewall openings — no destructive, security-weakening, or unexplained mutations were found. The main hygiene gap is that the Python test listener processes and their /tmp files (listen.py, l8080.log/pid, l23.log/pid, reboot.log) on node2 and node3 were left running and in place after task completion rather than cleaned up, as confirmed in the after_executor snapshot listening-sockets and temporary-files diffs. This residue is low-risk (loopback test servers, not part of the transit ACL enforcement path) but was not reverted.
